notes.title: Bad Business Is Available Now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079440/Bad_Business/

Did you ever want to be a rabbit that is also a hitman? Well have we got great news for you then, because Bad Business is out now!!

Bad Business is an extremely challenging top-down tactical shooter game where Mr. Bunny Rabbit, a hitman for the Mob, has been tasked to neutralize the rival Gang. A hard task for any organization, an impossible task for a hitman.

Be sure to join us on [url=discord.hut90.com]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=twitter.com/Hut_90]Twitter[/url] for all the latest news about Bad Business and all our other games.

[b]If you like the game, consider leaving us a [url=store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/1079440]review[/url] or recommending the game to your friends.[/b]
